mechanism: User-requested delegated source-image review in current session; no separate paid API calls
source_handling: Local PDF renders and ignored data outputs; no external upload/publishing tool used
raw_outputs: Per-batch review.jsonl, provenance.json or prompt/provenance.json, and intermediate snapshot ledgers
parent_qa: All 93 initially proposed non-symbol word edits inspected on 12 source-image sheets; 13 rejections/uncertainties recorded. Initial glyph mappings and Unicode encoding defects were challenged and revised. Model source_checked is a claim, not independent validation.
prompt_scope: Every flag: retain recognized legal terms/names without dictionary auto-correction; read source for malformed tokens/symbols; exact-span proposals only; preserve printed typos; mark uncertainty; save image hashes. Follow-up QA instructions are reflected in saved model snapshots and parent override log. Full conversational prompt text remains in this session transcript.
limitations: AI-to-AI checks do not supply human gold
Word-frequency absence is not an error
Residual valid-word/number OCR defects can escape lexical screening
